description: This Java source file defines a class 'ActionsPresets' that provides various preset configurations for notification actions in an Android wearable notification context. It includes nested classes for different preset types, each implementing an 'apply' method to configure notification actions with different behaviors and appearances.

classes.name: ActionsPresets
classes.description: A collection of predefined notification action configurations for Android wearables.

classes.description: A preset with a single action.

classes.name: LongTitleActionPreset
classes.description: A preset with an action that has a long title.

classes.name: ReplyActionPreset
classes.description: A preset with a reply action including remote input.

classes.name: ReplyWithChoicesActionPreset
classes.description: A reply action preset with predefined choices.

classes.name: DifferentActionsOnPhoneAndWearable
classes.description: A preset with different actions for phone and wearable.
